trial_court: Additional Senior Civil Judge, Viramgam, Ahmedabad (rural), H.M.P NO. 24 of 2009
facts_of_case: The applicant married the opponent in 2006 and got a divorce in 2007 without her consent. She filed a civil suit for declaration of marriage as legal and the divorce deed as void. She also filed a Hindu Marriage Petition for restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that the transfer of proceedings is necessary.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, the present application has been filed. The opponent has filed H.M.P No. 24 of 2009 under section 29(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act before learned Civil Judge (S.D) Ahmedabad (Rural) which is pending.

legal_principles.principle: A court may transfer proceedings to a competent court if necessary.
legal_principles.held: The present applicant has prayed to transfer the proceedings of case being H.M.P NO. 24 of 2009 pending before learned Additional Senior Civil Judge, Viramgam, Ahmedabad (rural) to the competent court at Vadodara District.

outcome.final_order: The present application has been allowed.
